title: Cyril of Jerusalem on Lamentations 1:1
body: “Read the Lamentations; for in those Lamentations, Jeremias, lamenting you, wrote what is worthy of lamentations.”
author: Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lectures
bodyEs: “Lee las Lamentaciones; porque en aquellas Lamentaciones, Jeremías, lamentando a ustedes, escribió lo que es digno de lamentaciones.”
